description: Search Property24 listings across South Africa, Namibia, Botswana, Zambia, Zimbabwe, Mozambique and Kenya, paste search or listing URLs, or read area sold-price trends. No login, cookies or API key needed.

auctionsOnly.description: Only include listings carrying Property24's auction badge (mode=search).
auctionsOnly.title: Auctions only

bankRepossessionsOnly.description: Search Property24's bank-repossession facet (mode=search). Matches are tagged `isBankRepossession: true`.
bankRepossessionsOnly.title: Bank repossessions only

bathroomsMin.description: Only include listings with at least this many bathrooms. Half bathrooms count as decimals at the source and are compared correctly.
bathroomsMin.title: Minimum bathrooms

bedroomsMin.description: Only include listings with at least this many bedrooms. Studios count as 0.
bedroomsMin.title: Minimum bedrooms

country.description: Which Property24 edition to search. South Africa has the largest inventory; the other editions use their own currencies and city indexes.
country.title: Country edition

erfSizeMax.description: Only include listings whose erf (land) size is at most this many square metres.
erfSizeMax.title: Maximum erf / land size (m²)

erfSizeMin.description: Only include listings whose erf (land) size is at least this many square metres. Houses, farms and plots often publish erf size instead of floor size.
erfSizeMin.title: Minimum erf / land size (m²)

floorSizeMax.description: Only include listings whose building floor size is at most this many square metres.
floorSizeMax.title: Maximum floor size (m²)

floorSizeMin.description: Only include listings whose building floor size is at least this many square metres. Listings without a published floor size are kept.
floorSizeMin.title: Minimum floor size (m²)

includeFullDetails.description: Open each result's detail page for the full description, levies, rates and taxes, erf/floor size, price per m², features, agents and photo gallery. Adds one request per listing and makes runs slower. Always on for mode=byUrls.
includeFullDetails.title: Fetch full listing details

listingUrls.description: Specific Property24 listing pages to fetch, for example `https://www.property24.com/for-sale/blyde-riverwalk-estate/pretoria/gauteng/33014/116170024`.
listingUrls.title: Listing URLs (mode=byUrls)

location.description: A city, suburb or area name, for example `Sandton`, `Sea Point, Cape Town` or `Windhoek`. Leave empty to search the selected province (South Africa) or the whole country edition. Ignored when mode is `searchUrls`.
location.title: Area name (optional)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Use 20 for a test run, or up to 10,000 for a full area sweep. Deep searches may hit Property24's own inventory ceiling.
maxItems.title: Maximum results

maxPages.description: Hard cap on search pages per search URL. 0 lets the actor decide from Maximum results and the site's own next-page link.
maxPages.title: Maximum result pages

mode.description: Choose how to start: search with the filters below, paste Property24 search URLs, look up specific listing URLs, or read public area sold-price trends.
mode.title: What to scrape

onShowOnly.description: Only include listings with a scheduled show day (mode=search). The show date is returned as `onShowDate` when published.
onShowOnly.title: On-show listings only

parkingMin.description: Only include listings with at least this many parking spaces or garages.
parkingMin.title: Minimum parking spaces

priceMax.description: Highest price in the edition's own currency. Leave empty for no maximum.
priceMax.title: Maximum price

priceMin.description: Lowest price in the edition's own currency (ZAR for South Africa). Leave empty for no minimum.
priceMin.title: Minimum price

province.description: Province to search when country is South Africa and no area name is given (mode=search).
province.title: South African province

searchUrls.description: Property24 search pages to scrape, for example `https://www.property24.com/for-sale/cape-town/western-cape/432`. Filters and sort already in each URL are kept. Any edition can be mixed.
searchUrls.title: Search result URLs (mode=searchUrls)

title: Property24 Scraper Input
